UMData listing: St. Paul's United Methodist Church, Tucson - Active

notes: Facts confirmed 2026-09-10 from the church's own site. Address is 8051 E Broadway Blvd, Tucson AZ 85710. The leadership and staff page lists exactly one clergy member, Rev. Ron V. Bartlow, Senior Pastor - his bio says St. Paul's is his eighth UMC appointment and he describes himself as 'a preacher and teacher'. His wife Lynn Bartlow is a pastor at St. Mark's UMC on the northwest side and is NOT staff here; do not attribute St. Paul's sermons to her. The sermon archive at /worship/ carries additional preacher names alongside Bartlow (a retired guest pastor and lay/supply speakers), so attribute each sermon individually rather than assuming Bartlow preached it. Sermon video is on YouTube at @stpaulsumctucson (two Sunday services, 9:00 and 10:30) and on the church's Facebook page. UMC clergy are reappointed regularly, so re-check the appointment each year. Coordinates still need tools/geocode.py.
